sm: Protestia reports that former 19 Kids and Counting star Josh Duggar has suffered another setback in trying to overturn his 2021 conviction for possessing and distributing child sexual abuse material. He received twelve and a half years, between the twenty years prosecutors wanted and the five his defense sought. In 2025 a federal judge declined to hear his appeal because the required paperwork arrived weeks late, and the judge called his account of timely filing not credible. The Eighth Circuit then denied a certificate of appealability and dismissed the appeal. His only remaining option is the Supreme Court, which the report calls a long shot, and he would be forty-seven on release. The editor's note says prosecutors argued at sentencing that he showed no interest in counseling and insisted he was framed, which they said made him a greater risk to reoffend.
